entities.name: St. Peter and St. Paul's Church, Tbilisi
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The St. Peter and St. Paul's Church is a Roman Catholic church in Tbilisi, the Georgian capital. Pope John Paul II celebrated Mass there during his visit to Georgia in October 1999.
